opportunities.title: Sly Flourish Says Skip the Stat Block — Here's the 5e/DCC Version of 'Lazy Monsters'
opportunities.why_now: Sly Flourish just published a Daggerheart improvised-monster method that maps directly onto the 'reskin on the fly' technique 5e and DCC GMs already lean on.
opportunities.angle: Side-by-side short: take his 3-stat lazy monster formula and show it running live in a 5e combat vs. a DCC combat, same monster, two systems, 60 seconds.

opportunities.title: Dark Sun's Original Designers Are Building a New World — Here's the Thri-kreen Tactic That Made the Original Broken
opportunities.why_now: EN World's podcast just confirmed Dark Sun's original creators are working on a new setting, reviving interest in the Dark Sun stat blocks veteran GMs remember fondly.
opportunities.angle: Creature tactic short: thri-kreen pack ambush + psionics abuse in 5e, framed as 'here's why the original Dark Sun terrified low-level parties.'

opportunities.title: Monster Hunter Wilds' Boost Bracer Is a Free Monster Ability — Steal It for Your Next Boss Fight
opportunities.why_now: RPGSite's Boost Bracer showcase gives a concrete video-game mechanic (timed buff window on a telegraphed monster action) that translates cleanly into tabletop monster design.
opportunities.angle: Homebrew monster tactic short: convert Boost Bracer into a legendary action variant for a 5e/Shadowdark boss, with the exact trigger and DC.

opportunities.title: Dragon's Dogma 2's Pawn Patch Just Fixed What Shadowdark's Hireling Rules Get Wrong
opportunities.why_now: DD2's new title update reworks pawn AI/behavior, a timely hook to critique how Shadowdark and 5e handle hireling initiative and loyalty.
opportunities.angle: Rules ruling short: 'How I run hireling initiative and morale checks so they don't play themselves' — direct comparison to the DD2 patch notes.

opportunities.title: Starting a TTRPG Podcast? Here's the One Ruling You Need Before Episode One
opportunities.why_now: EN World's 'launch your own podcast' guide is trending among GMs, giving a natural tie-in to pivot toward a quick, opinionated rules-ruling format instead.
opportunities.angle: Meta/wry short poking fun at podcast overhead vs. the channel's own daily one-ruling format — ends with a genuine spell/monster ruling as proof of concept.
